profile.name: HP 3456A 六位半台式数字万用表
profile.description: 这是一台六位半台式数字万用表，用于高精度直流/交流电压、电阻和比值测量，支持二线/四线电阻以及统计、dB/dBm、相对值等数学功能，常用于电子测试、器件表征和校准实验。
profile.description_en: A 6.5-digit bench digital multimeter for precision DC/AC voltage, resistance, and ratio measurements. It supports 2-wire/4-wire resistance and built-in math functions such as statistics, dB/dBm, and relative measurements, making it suitable for electronics testing, device characterization, and calibration work.
